correctness.rationale: For four-symbol DNA words with exactly two C/G letters, reverse-complement closure and no fixed strands, 96 possible balanced words have 8 fixed and 44 nontrivial two-strand orbits; four orbits self-conflict under the closed 0/one-adjacent-swap balls. The remaining 40 orbits form a 100-edge graph with connected component sizes 4,6,6,12,12. Independent reconstruction of each swap ball and exhaustive independent-set enumeration gives component (size,alpha,opt-count) (4,1,4), twice (6,2,3), twice (12,3,12). Thus maximum is 2*(1+2+2+3+3)=22 codewords and labeled equality count 4*3*3*12*12=5184. An alternative multiset graph recursion corroborates unrestricted 25. Every finite choice is checked, so this finite enumeration is exhaustive rather than extrapolated.
